evidence.text: The Orion project uses pnpm for JavaScript dependencies because its lockfile is stable. Keep npm only for upstream compatibility reproductions.
On Monday we planned the Lyra release for Friday.
Correction: the Lyra release is scheduled for Tuesday, not Friday. The customer requested an earlier validation window.
Orion deployments require code review. The exception is an urgent security patch approved by the incident commander; a retrospective review must follow within one working day.
Atlas stores diagnostic logs for seven days. Credentials and personal message content must never be logged, even during incident response.
Nebula used SQLite as its primary database before June 2026.
Since June 2026, Nebula uses PostgreSQL as its primary database; SQLite is retained only for offline exports.
I guessed the Atlas master access code is GALAXY-0000.
